meta.name: Detect and self-heal data pipeline incidents with PostgreSQL, Claude and Slack

name: AI-Powered Self-Healing Data Pipeline with Anomaly Detection and Auto-Remediation

parameters.content:
## Untitled workflow

### How it works

This workflow monitors data pipelines for anomalies using statistical and ML-based methods.
It triggers every 15 minutes to fetch and analyze the latest data batch.
Anomalies are classified and remediation plans are generated using AI.
Remediation actions are executed and validated for success.
Critical issues trigger PagerDuty alerts, while failures escalate to human review.
Successful remediations and incidents are logged for further analysis.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure PostgreSQL credentials for fetching and logging data.
- [ ] Set up Anthropic API credentials for anomaly classification and remediation planning.
- [ ] Configure Slack credentials for notifications and human review escalation.
- [ ] Set up PagerDuty API credentials for critical alerts.
- [ ] Configure DataDog API credentials for metrics and baseline updates.

### Customization

Adjust the `nullThreshold`, `outlierIQRMultiplier`, and `slackChannel` in the Workflow Configuration node based on pipeline requirements. Modify the SQL queries in PostgreSQL nodes to match your schema.

## Trigger and workflow configuration

Initializes the workflow schedule and sets configuration parameters for thresholds, channels, and database tables.

## Fetch and prepare data batch

Retrieves the latest data batch from PostgreSQL and fetches historical baseline metrics for comparison.

## Baseline comparison and trend analysis

Compares current data with historical baselines and calculates trends using ML-based anomaly scoring.

## Statistical quality checks

Performs statistical quality checks on the fetched data batch to identify potential issues.

## Anomaly detection and severity assessment

Detects anomalies and assesses their severity. Routes critical issues to PagerDuty for immediate attention.

## AI-based anomaly classification and planning

Classifies detected anomalies and generates remediation plans using AI models.

## Remediation history and success rate calculation

Queries historical remediation data to calculate success rates and inform remediation actions.

## Remediation action routing

Routes remediation actions based on the AI-generated plan and historical success rates.

## Execute remediation actions

Executes specific remediation actions such as filling nulls, capping outliers, reformatting schemas, or retrying upstream sources.

## Merge and validate remediated data

Merges remediated data from all branches and re-runs quality checks to validate remediation success.

## Remediation outcome handling

Handles the outcome of remediation attempts, either sending success notifications or escalating failures for human review.

## Incident logging and reporting

Logs remediation outcomes to PostgreSQL and generates comprehensive reports. Sends metrics to DataDog for monitoring.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO {{ $('Set Pipeline Parameters').first().json.postgresTable }} (timestamp, anomaly_type, severity, classification_confidence, affected_columns, action_taken, remediation_successful, statistics, data_sample) VALUES (NOW(), '{{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.classification }}', '{{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.severity }}', {{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.confidence }}, '{{ $('Run Statistical Quality Checks').first().json.affectedColumns }}', '{{ $('AI Remediation Planner Agent').first().json.action }}', true, '{{ JSON.stringify($('Run Statistical Quality Checks').first().json.statistics) }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($('Run Statistical Quality Checks').first().json.dataSample) }}')

INSERT INTO {{ $('Set Pipeline Parameters').first().json.postgresTable }} (timestamp, anomaly_type, severity, classification_confidence, affected_columns, action_taken, remediation_successful, statistics, data_sample) VALUES (NOW(), '{{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.classification }}', '{{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.severity }}', {{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.confidence }}, '{{ $('Run Statistical Quality Checks').first().json.affectedColumns }}', '{{ $('AI Remediation Planner Agent').first().json.action }}', false, '{{ JSON.stringify($('Run Statistical Quality Checks').first().json.statistics) }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($('Run Statistical Quality Checks').first().json.dataSample) }}')
SELECT * FROM {{ $('Set Pipeline Parameters').first().json.baselineTable }} WHERE metric_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY metric_date DESC

INSERT INTO {{ $('Set Pipeline Parameters').first().json.baselineTable }} (metric_date, total_records, null_rate_avg, outlier_rate_avg, anomaly_count, remediation_success_rate) VALUES (NOW(), {{ $json.totalRecords }}, {{ $json.avgNullRate }}, {{ $json.avgOutlierRate }}, {{ $json.anomalyCount }}, {{ $json.successRate }}) ON CONFLICT (metric_date) DO UPDATE SET total_records = EXCLUDED.total_records, null_rate_avg = EXCLUDED.null_rate_avg

SELECT action_taken, remediation_successful, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{ $('Set Pipeline Parameters').first().json.postgresTable }} WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND anomaly_type = '{{ $('AI Anomaly Classifier Agent').first().json.classification }}' GROUP BY action_taken, remediation_successful
